newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Oil Search sees Moran hydrocarbon shows.
newsitem.headline: Oil Search sees Moran hydrocarbon shows.

text.p: Oil and gas explorer and producer Oil Search Ltd said on Tuesday it has encountered hydrocarbon shows in the Moran-3X well in Papua New Guinea.
The shows were seen between 1,658 metres and 1,710 metres, well before the well's eventual target area, which is nearer the 4,000 metre mark.
"We didn't expect to see this. It's positive but we don't know if it is significant," said Oil Search chief financial officer Nigel Hartley.
The Moran-3X well, in PPL-161, is designed to delineate the extent of the Moran discovery to the south-east of the Moran-1X well.
Earlier, Moran results have been seen by analysts as supporting predictions that the field could hold more recoverable reserves than the 305 million barrels of oil in the nearby Kutubu field.
Hartley said the quality and significance of the latest shows would be evaluated by electric logging.

The PPL-161 licence holders are: Oil Search, 35.017 percent; Chevron unit and operator Chevron Niugini Pty Ltd, 25.0 percent; Mobil Corp unit Ampolex (Highlands) Pty Ltd, 21.233 percent; BHP Petroleum (PNG) Inc, 12.50 percent; and Mitsubishi unit Merlin Petroleum Co, 6.25 percent.
